texts: The main proven advantage of off-pump CABG over on-pump CABG is fewer blood transfusions.
Avoiding the bypass circuit spares the haemodilution and platelet damage that cause bleeding.
Large randomised trials such as ROOBY, CORONARY and GOPCABE found no clear difference in stroke, perioperative infarction or death, and ROOBY found worse one-year graft patency off pump.
In the picture, the scale weighs the octopus and the pump truck the same in lightning, stag and coin purse, and only the bag of red doughnuts stays sealed.
Memory hook: the octopus saves the doughnuts, nothing more.
